validation.workflow: First-time entry asks whether to try from scratch or browse completed examples. A prominent two-option login switcher selects only the matching 7 practice or 15 completed-demo accounts. Remembered selection, explicit deep links and returning sessions remain supported. Entry switching logs out only the destination session when needed, preserving all stored records, documents and histories. Stale OTP and phone do not cross lanes. Existing product/staff workspaces remain unchanged.
